## Notes

**Quick read:** Protected creator; a teacher and mom of a very heavy toddler boy (15 months and about 25 to 26 lbs in the summer) who made just two short outdoor videos, and they are among the best converters on the roster (66 purchases, $4,024 on $2,250 spend, ROAS 1.79).
**Best next move:** a warm personal check-in with this week's inspo to get more videos out of her (no commission talk); she has four samples (Light Palms, Brown, Checkered, pocket) and has not submitted since Sep 2.

### Style (from watching her videos)
- On camera: blonde mom with hair in a bun, sometimes glasses, black tee and denim shorts, smartwatch. Toddler son in a blue shirt, heavy and sturdy. Setting: an open grassy field under dramatic stormy clouds, both videos in the same spot. Light Palms sling.
- Format: short yapper with voiceover and stylish burned-in captions (script font on key words), 13 to 23 seconds. Energetic, waves at the camera, walks toward it, close-up of the buckle, holds up the empty seat. Hooks: "Tired of carrying a 25-pound toddler? Same.", "If you have a heavy toddler, what have we been doing without this?", "This 26-pound guy is a Stage 5 Clinger". Angles: heavy toddler, weight relief, patterns, sale.
- What worked: 71b1b23e (Aug 13, she re-uploaded with better volume) ran in 2 ads; adbc589c (Sep 2) in 1 ad. Both approved. Heavy toddler plus weight number is a strong, specific hook.
- Safety and checklist: seat under his bottom and legs out on the hip looks right. Issues: 71b1b23e says "it's made for six months up to five years old" (wrong; the range is 10 to 50 lbs, stated by weight, never age). adbc589c says she would "never go back to bulky strollers or just carrying him myself". In both she waves and gestures with one hand; at 2s in adbc589c an arm is flung wide and the other hand is not clearly on him. Burned-in captions (checklist 6) and summer sale lines that are now out of date.
- Strengths: short, punchy and specific (weights, "Stage 5 Clinger"), converts on very little content, great natural energy.
- To improve: say "10 to 50 lbs"; keep a hand visibly on him while waving; film without captions and without sale lines so the ads keep running into Q4.
